The circuit and schematic images did not render, so the layout is inferred from the text: five LEDs on pins 2-6, each in series with a 220 ohm resistor, cathodes to GND.
Each branch is Uno pin -> wire -> breadboard top strip -> 220 ohm resistor across the centre gap -> bottom strip -> LED anode. The resistor is on the anode side.

Every LED cathode goes to the bottom negative rail (bn), and one wire links that rail to Uno GND.1. The rail holes are numbered by the branch column, plus bn.20 for the ground wire. Each rail is one strip.
Branch columns are 1, 4, 7, 10 and 13. LED legs are placed in the bottom half (row j) and the adjacent rail, which is a simplification of the physical leg spacing.
Pin order: pin 2 -> led1 ('a'), 3 -> led2 ('b'), 4 -> led3 ('c'), 5 -> led4 ('d'), 6 -> led5 ('e').
